characters.name: Amata Sora
characters.description: A boy with the power of levitation amplified by intense emotions. Once shunned as a child due to his powers, he has since started wearing boots inlaid with pockets with which he can place weights so as to keep him aground every time. A chance encounter with Mikono, however, ultimately forces him to start embracing his powers. In the series, he is the main pilot of Aquarion EVOL. InAquarion Love, he takes over as Aquarion Gepard's pilot after Zessica is defeated by Apollo. All of the Other Reindeer: Suffered a moderate one as a child when his levitation powers went off in the middle of a group of kids, hence the reason he wears pocketed boots with which he can place weights. Always Save the Girl: Protecting Mikono is always his top priority in his mind no matter the circumstance. Animals Hate Him: Mikono's pet "cat" Shu-Shu can't stand him.

characters.name: Mikono Suzushiro
characters.description: A girl hailing from a well-respected family of Element Users who is apparently born without any powers, causing her to become a withdrawn, shy girl who has to rely on her older brother Cayenne. After being saved by Amata, she ends up joining him at Neo DEAVA, whose higher-ups speculate that she may have the power to amplify the Aquarion. She also has a pet rabbit named Shu-Shu, who can hide in her hair like an accessory. All Girls Want Bad Boys: She's attracted toKagura, which seems to confuse even her as to why this would be the case.She's actually drawn to the other half of her past life lover Apollo's soul. Always Someone Better: How she feels about her brother Cayenne, who according to her, has everything. Beautiful Tears: When she first meets Amata, he sees her crying after watching the movie "Skies of Aquaria" and he blushes at how cute she is. Betty and Veronica: She's the well-mannered and demure Betty to Zessica's flirtatious and provocatively dressed Veronica. Mikono is the one who gets Amata.

characters.name: Kagura Demuri
characters.description: One of Izumo's two main subordinates and a hot-blooded warrior who loves charging into battle headlong with Mithra Gnis, a machine suited for melee combat and Kagura's tendency to move around like a quadrupedal beast. He gains the ability of "Reversal". Late in the series he pilots the original Solar Aquarion, still golden as when it was last seen. InAquarion Love, he is the sole pilot of Aquarion EVOL. Animorphism: He can change to a black wolf from time to time. On episode 11,after Mykage awakes his(fake)Genetic Memory, it gainsred eyesand matching fur. Attack! Attack! Attack!: He never retreats from battle until he wins, even when it's clear that he's on disadvantage. Most of the times he gets whisked away by Mykage at the last moment. Attack Reflector:Has gained the power to reverse, which allowed him to reflect Amata's Mugen Punch.

characters.name: Zessica Wong
characters.description: A girl from Neo DEAVA who would like engaging with the opposite sex more. Showing no inhibition about cross-gender Unions (earning her MIX and Suomi's scolding), she also started taking interest in Amata, going so far as to tease him just to see him float around, much to Mikono's jealousy. She is the second most frequent user of Aquarion Gepard, though she's more famous for her one-time use of Aquarion Spada. Anguished Declaration of Love:In episode 16, she confesses her feelings to Amata in the middle of an emotional outburst. Her timing couldn't be worse because they're inside the Aquarion and her romantic feelings cause it to go berserk. Badass in Distress: AfterMykage unwillingly possesses her. Betty and Veronica: The flirtatious and provocatively dressed Veronica to Mikono's well-mannered and demure Betty. She loses.

characters.name: Cayenne Suzushiro
characters.description: Mikono's older brother and aChick Magnet(though to a lesser extent than Shrade). His power is psychic vision through a red point of light emanating from his forehead (like aThird Eyeof sorts). He is the most frequent pilot of Aquarion Gepard. Aloof Big Brother: He cares for Mikono and thinks he must protect her, but there's poor emotional connection and communication between the siblings because of Mikono's insecurities about her apparent lack of an Element power and Cayenne looking down on her because of it. Their relationship improves a bit later as Cayenne realizes Mikono isn't the defenseless little girl who couldn't do anything by herself anymore. Big Brother Instinct:Deconstructed: he's been quite protective of his little sister Mikono since they were kids, but unfortunately, it took him years to realize that she can actually stand on her own feet now and no longerneedshis protection. Blessed with Suck: His Element ability of prophecy allows him to become an excellent sniper. However, he is also haunted by visions of Mikono perishing through a chain of events apparently linked to the Aquarion, and thus he tries his best to keep Mikono safe, even if he has to demoralize her to accomplish it.

characters.name: Andy W. Hole
characters.description: Andy can find any weak point in any structure and has control over the power of the earth. Out of all the boys of Neo DEAVA, he is the most eager to make contact with girls. Attack Its Weak Point: He creates tunnels by finding the weakpoint in the structure of the material and crumbling it down into a hole. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With MIX. They butt heads whenever they're together, but become attracted to each other over time. Beta Couple: As Amata'sBromantic Foil, Andy has a growing romantic relationship of his own with MIX while Amata must deal with the love square mess. Big Damn Heroes:Saves Amata and Mikono from Kagura in Episode 13 by creating a hole beneath the latter's feet.

characters.name: MIX
characters.description: MIX starts off as a strict, serious girl. Her power was creating enclosures and covering up any weak spots. In the series, she is the only other person to pilot Aquarion EVOL besides Amata. Barrier Warrior: She uses her powers to clog three enemy Abductors' weapons and propulsion systems. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Andy. They butt heads because of their clashing personalities, yet they end up developing feelings for each other. Beta Couple: She gradually forms a romantic relationship with Amata'sBromantic FoilAndy. It was slow to develop because of theirBelligerent Sexual Tension, but they still have it easy compared to the main love square mixed with complicatedReincarnation Romancestuff.

characters.name: Shrade Elan
characters.description: Neo DEAVA's smartest and most popular student, whose poor health prevents him from going to active service. His power is using sound to manipulate brainwaves. He is the most frequent pilot of Aquarion Spada. The Ace: Mentioned as being the top student at Neo-DEAVA, so good that he isn't even required to participate in training. He's also an incredible piano and violin player. His only drawback is his frail health. Back for the Finale:His spirit brings his Vector back and gives his power to Cayenne to help him against Mykage. Blessed with Suck: His Element power caused many of those he knew, including his own parents, to murder each other. This has lead to him being rather... cold toward most of the other characters: he isn't exactly unkind to them, but he doesn't really seem to care much about anything either, with the possible exception of Cayenne.

characters.name: Yunoha Surool
characters.description: A little girl with the power to turn herself invisible. Until Amata encouraged her to come out of her shell, all that is seen of her is a green frog-like doll she always carries around. Birds of a Feather: With Jin. Both are quiet and socially withdrawn people. Yunoha becomes interested in Jin because he reminds her so much of herself before she started to make friends and tries to bring him out of his shell. Covert Pervert: She bought a picture of a half-naked Amata. Cursed with Awesome: She has great misgivings about her powers, which make many think she's a ghost. Though it turns out to be pretty useful in their second fight against Jin's Radius Gnis, where she can turn the Aquarion invisible and thus impervious to damage, allowing Amata to finish it off with the "Subliminal Punch." The Cutie: She's the most adorable and sweetest character of the main cast.

characters.name: Sazanka Bianca
characters.description: An energetic girl in rustic clothes. She is partnered with Cayenne Suzushiro and Shrade Elan in the Emotion Test conducted by Neo-DEAVA on Neo-Kowloon. Camera Fiend: She takes pictures of her classmates in her spare time. She even has a business of selling pictures of her classmates to each other, strangely being noted as impossible to have taken shots of, due to being in another location when it happened. Fangirl: Like her fellow girl students, she admires both Cayenne and Shrade. Genki Girl: She's very bright and energetic. Girlish Pigtails: Her hair is tied into twin braids, emphasizing her girlish and energetic character.

characters.name: Malloy Direzza
characters.description: A handsome dark-skinned student with the power to destabilize objects. Attack Its Weak Point: His Element give him the ability to severely weaken objects. Long-Range Fighter: He uses his abilities to launch assault attacks with a long-range artillery machine, which would normally be disadvantageous in close-quarters combat. Nice Guy: Because of his friendly personality, he's well-liked by his classmates. Power Glows: His Element makes his hand glow.

characters.name: Donar Dantes
characters.description: A veteran soldier and instructor of the male side of Neo DEAVA, Donar has a pair of prosthetic arms to replace those he lost. He also used to be sharpshooter. Alliterative Name:DonarDantes. Artificial Limbs: In the Aquarion Disaster, Donar lost his arms, and they have since been replaced with mechanical prosthetics. Badass Transplant: His prosthetic arms can store weapons, such as tasers and bowguns. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Suomi. They get into arguments, but there's signs of attraction between them.

characters.name: Suomi Conebi
characters.description: Instructor of the female side of Neo DEAVA. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Donar. Suomi has hints of misandry and can be sometimes seen in mild arguments with Donar, but there's hints of attraction between them. Covert Pervert: In Episode 8, while watching Mikono's spirit levels rapidly rising due to embarrassment over Amata seeing her half-naked, she describes to Donar the excitement of being stared at while half-naked. Hidden Buxom: She appears to have a rather modest figure in her usual nun-like outfit, but in theBeach Episode, her swimsuit reveals she has a fairly big bust. Hot Teacher: She's an attractive woman dressed like a nun and runs Neo-DEAVA's female academy. In theBeach Episode, the male students think she looks hot in a swimsuit.

characters.name: Principal/Commander
characters.description: Current instructor of Neo DEAVA. Everyone Calls Him "Barkeep": He's only known as "The Principal" and his actual name is never mentioned. Put on a Bus: Disappeared for a while after Zen and Crea reappeared, then makes occasionalreappearanceson Episodes 9 and 12.

characters.name: Zen Fudo
characters.description: High Commander of Neo DEAVA who offers guidance to the students in his own unusual way. Big Good: High Commander of Neo DEAVA. Classy Cravat: He's a High Commander dressed like a nobleman, including a cravat on the front of his neck. Eccentric Mentor: He gives a lot of metaphors to assist the people in Neo-DEAVA to develop themselves. Expy Coexistence: His design, role and even name are very similar to those of Gen Fudo fromthe previous series.The finale revealsthey're in fact the same character.

characters.name: Crea Drosera
characters.description: A childlike girl with an IQ of 300 and Chairwoman of Neo DEAVA. She is also responsible for giving approval for Unions. Elegant Gothic Lolita: She wears a black lolita dress decorated with ribbons and frills. Expy Coexistence: HerVictorian dress style, long silver hair, composed demeanor and teleportation power all strongly remind of Rena Rune fromthe previous series. She even sits in Rena's wheelchair in the simulation flashback of episode 23. Improbably High I.Q.: She's a genius with an IQ beyond 300. Shipper on Deck: She seems to support the idea of Donar and Suomi becoming a couple.

characters.name: Izumo Kamurogi
characters.description: Supreme Commander of Altair. He has his men cross through dimensions to Vega in an attempt to save their world. He pilots the Ahura Gnis. Anti-Villain: He had good intentions from the start, but one wonders why his first actions waskidnappingpeople rather than, say, peacefully contacting Vega and asking for their help. Catch and Return: His mech's primary ability is to absorb the attacks of others and return them twofold. Dark Is Not Evil: Wears darker clothing, sports the traditional evil goatee, and intimidating-looking, but otherwise Izumo is a reasonable enemy commanderwith noble intentions. This stands in stark contrast toMykage, whose angelic appearancemasks his selfish desires.

characters.name: Jin Muso
characters.description: Izumo's other subordinate and a cunning strategist. Unlike the hot-headed Kagura, Jin prefers manipulating AbductorMooksfrom high up in space or puppet-controlling Radius Gnis, a machine suited for long-range combat which complements his natural ability to generate energy shields. Accidental Pervert: In Episode 10, he finally does what Andy has yet to — infiltrate the girls' changing room (although unintentionally on his part). Always with You: The Director's cut reveals thatafter dying his soul entered Yunoha's plushie, allowing him to be with her again. Barrier Warrior: His Element power allows him to create energy barriers. Birds of a Feather: With Yunoha. They're two quiet and socially withdrawn people who quickly feel drawn to each other.

characters.name: Mykage Towano
characters.description: A Priest of Altair who has recently awoken from stasis in a glass-like encasing. Alien Blood: His blood is blue. Alien Hair: He has feathers instead of hair. Astral Projection: One of his abilities. Big Bad: The most dangerous and villainous character.

characters.name: Alicia
characters.description: A famous actress in Vega who played Sylvie's part in "Skies of Aquaria", a feature film based on events of the original Aquarion series 12,000 years before. Chekhov M.I.A.: She went missing some years before the start of the series. Turns out she has been held captive in Altair all along. Missing Mom:She is revealed to be Amata's mother, who abandoned him in order to go to Altair to help Izumo deal with the Curse of Eve. Together in Death:Towards the end of the series, Alicia and Izumo die. They go to the afterlife together after saying goodbye to their son.

characters.name: Shu-Shu
characters.description: Black Bead Eyes: It has a pair of dots for eyes. Call a Smeerp a "Rabbit": Shu-Shu is a small, white ball with two long bunny-like ears and whiskers. Its owner Mikono says Shu-Shu is a cat, but it doesn't look anything like one. Empathy Pet: Shu-Shu sometimes mimics Mikono's emotions, such as its ears forming a heart when Amata gives an over-the-top apology to Mikono. Head Pet: Shu-Shu likes to hide inside Mikono's hair bun. Its long ears sticking out also would make anyone think Mikono is wearing a ribbon at first.

characters.name: Mr. Suzushiro
characters.description: Mikono's and Cayenne's father Invisible Parents: He never shows up in person. The audience only becomes aware of his existence through a letter. Parental Favoritism: After he finds out that Mikono is been enrolled in Neo DEAVA (18 episodes later, mind you), the response he writes in his letter to Cayenne is basically, "What the heck is she doing with Cayenne? She's useless after all." Unnamed Parent: His given name is never mentioned.

characters.name: Shin Tsukishima
characters.description: A 15-year-old boy living in Showa-era Japan. Hiding Behind Your Bangs: Being Jin's lookalike, Shin's hair covers the upper half of his face and he's very much an introvert who likes spending time alone. Identical Stranger: He bares a strong resemblance to Jin. Love at First Sight: He falls for Yuno the moment he meets her.

characters.name: Yuno Kawazu
characters.description: A 16-year-old girl living in Showa-era Japan. Cute Bookworm: She has the Book of Holy Genesis, which she considers herOnly Friend. Identical Stranger: She bares a strong resemblance to Yunoha. Older Than She Looks: She's actually older than Shin, but she looks like a preteen girl. Shrinking Violet: Just as shy as Yunoha.

characters.name: Apollo
characters.description: The protagonist ofGenesis of Aquarion. As in the original series, he is the main pilot of Solar Aquarion. Let's You and Him Fight: He doesn't like Kagura's scent; the latter feels the same way. Both see this as a good reason to start an Aquarion showdown.

characters.name: Silvia
characters.description: The heroine ofGenesis of Aquarion.

characters.name: Reika
characters.description: One of Apollo and Silvia's comrades fromGenesis of Aquarion Unexpected Character: One would normally expect Sirius to complete theGenesistrio, butLovefeatures Reika instead. This is the reason some think that, despite the promotional video advertising it as a crossover between bothAquarionTV series, these are actually the OVA versions of the characters, since there, Reika is the third pilot instead,since Sirius is dead there.Turns out it really is the TV version of the characters, though.

characters.name: Gen Fudo
characters.description: The MentorfromGenesis of Aquarion, he seems to have transcended time and appears in the Showa-era

characters.name: Akira Kaibuki
characters.description: The main protagonist, Akira is a stoic and level-headed youngster who behaves according to his belief that he is bent into becoming a "savior". He pilots the red-colored Vector-01. Battle Couple: With Maia. The two fall in love as they overcome battles together. Betty and Veronica: He's the heroic and dependable Betty to Subete's villainous and unstable Veronica, with Maia as the Archie.He wins. Bodyguard Crush: Maia doubts Akira works so hard to protect her because he cares about her especially; he's just doing his job as a savior. However, Akira affirms he protects Maia because hewantsto. The Champion:Although he forgot it, Akira's goal for nearly his entire life was to be Maia's savior and save the world for her.

characters.name: Maia Tsukigane
characters.description: The main heroine. Maia was trained since childhood to be Subete's partner, she grew up blindly following Sougon's teachings until her first sortie when she is forced to combine with Akira and defeat the M.J.B.K. she was supposed to protect. After being held prisoner by DEAVA, she obtains a chance to return to NESTA, but Sougon instead instructs her to pretend that she switched sides in order to investigate Akira further. She pilots the purple-colored Vector-02, focused on air superiority. Action Girl: She was trained in combat since a young age. She shows she can handle herself even outside the Vectors. Apocalypse Maiden:Maia is the key to awakening the Aquarion Logos and causing theThe End of the World as We Know It. Artificial Human:She's actually a "doll" created from Nesta's soul using Subete's verbalism power. Battle Couple: She often team up with Akira when piloting and they gradually fall in love.

characters.name: Kokone Kikogami
characters.description: A shy girl who can barely talk. She aims to become an actress and joined the Verbalism Club in order to improve her speech. She soon falls in love with Akira and comes to view Maia as a rival. She pilots the white-colored Vector-03, specialized in enemy disruption and rear support. Alliterative Name:KokoneKikogami. Betty and Veronica: She's the shy and homely Betty to Maia's hot-tempered and exotic Veronica, with Akira as Archie. She loses. Bullied into Depression: Kokone's crippling social anxiety is the result of continuous bullying from her schoolmates when she was a kid. Bully Magnet: She was victim of bullying in elementary school because a boy she turned down died in an accident and everyone acted like it was her fault.

characters.name: Hayato Kujyo
characters.description: A cool-headed young man who aims to become a politician like his late father. He joined the Verbalism Club seeking to improve his speech. He pilots the blue-colored Vector-05, focused on mobility and high speed. Brainy Specs: Befitting his status asThe Smart Guy. Brutal Honesty: Hayato is one to say things the way they are, and doesn't like hiding behind niceties. It is mentioned that this gave him trouble with his peers. Intergenerational Friendship: Hayato seems to get along particularly well with Karan, seeing her as a little sister of sorts. The Resenter: He doesn't like how Akira's gut-instinct decisions always seem to work out for him.

characters.name: Tsutomu Domon
characters.description: A young aspiring comedian whose older brother is a famous comedian himself, and despite knowing that he is not near as talented as him, he seeks his own form of comedy, performing unusual sketches that so far earned him only one avid fan. He joined the Verbalism Club seeking to make use of the training against the M.J.B.K. to improve his comedy skills, and pilots the attack-oriented, yellow-colored Vector-04, specialized in hit and run tactics. The Big Guy: The largest and funniest member of the Verbalism Club. Casanova Wannabe: Tsutomu's attempts at picking up chicks are comically unsuccessful. Heroic Sacrifice:In Episode 21, he sacrifices his life to defeat theMonster of the Week. Official Couple: With Shouko, who agrees to become his girlfriend in episode 19.

characters.name: Karan Uminagi
characters.description: The youngest member of the team, Karan is a little girl who was aiming to become an idol and joined the Verbalism Club seeking support for her career, until Akira realizes that she wanted to be and idol just to please her mother's selfish desires and when he helped them reconcile, she started pursuing her true dream, which is to become a voice actor. She pilots the pink-colored Vector-06, specialized in reconnaissance and ambush. The Baby of the Bunch: The youngest member of the main cast. Girlish Pigtails: She sports them, to show her status as the youngest member of the team. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: A young and cheerful blonde child. Kid-Appeal Character: She's an elementary school student and the youngest member of the heroes' team. Her main purpose for being in the series is to be a source of cuteness and humor.

characters.name: Sakurako Soda
characters.description: DEAVA's chief of operations. She also manages the Shirobaco Maid Café which serves as a front for DEAVA's headquarters and as a place for Akira and the others to run several activities to train their Verbalism skills. Alliterative Name:SakurakoSoda. Big Good: The chief commander of DEAVA, in charge of defending humanity from the monsters Sougon releases. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: To Gen Fudou and his reincarnation Zen. Sakurako has a much closer relationship with DEAVA and is more personable with her recruits, though similar to Zen, she has a few quirks of her own and is quite eccentric. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: Being the commander of a group of defenders of humanity doesn't stop Sakurako from being eccentric and behaving like aCosplay Otaku Girlat times.

characters.name: Shouko Iwagami
characters.description: Sakurako's aid who works at DEAVA. Heartbroken Badass:Losing Tsutomu broke her heart, but she decides to keep going and join the battle to bring smiles to the world just as Tsutomu wanted. Her Heart Will Go On:She's heartbroken by Tsutomu's death, but encouraged by his final thoughts, she decides to live on and keep smiling just as he wanted. Muggle: She was scouted at first to be part of the Verbalism Club, but later it was revealed that she has no Verbaism power at all, which is a strange fact itself as it is said that every individual has some kind of Verbalism on itself, albeit weak....or rather, that's what the audience is led to believe. It's revealed late in the series' run that Shouko actually has theZero Verbalismability which lets her cancel Verbalism seals and spells. Nice Girl: She's nice and polite most of the time.

characters.name: Sougon Kenzaki
characters.description: The CEO of NESTA Communications. Big Bad: The main villain of the first half of the series.After his death, he's later replaced by Subete and Nesta. Corrupt Corporate Executive: Again, the CEO of an important company, and a main villain. Disc-One Final Boss:He is the major antagonist for the first half of the series, until he is eventually stopped and defeated by the Verbalism Club and crushed to his death by a falling boulder. Subete them takes up his position as the newBig Bad. Freudian Excuse: He came to hate the modern ways of communication and seek to destroy them becausesocial media resulted in the death of the woman he loved.

characters.name: Subete Kenzaki
characters.description: The heir of NESTA Communications and Sougon's son. He has feelings for Maia, the partner he was assigned to defend the MJBK's with. However, when Maia is forced to join DEAVA's side, he starts desperately looking for a way to bring her back to his side by all means possible. Betty and Veronica: He's the villainous and unstable Veronica to Akira's heroic and dependable Betty, with Maia as the Archie. He loses. Big Bad:He takes over the role of main villain after his father dies. Childhood Friend Romance: He has been in love with Maia ever since they were kids. The Chosen One: He is supposed to be tho one chosen by the power of Verbalism. He becomes angered when Akira seems to take his position.But turns out Subeteisthe chosen one, being the reincarnation of one of the original pilots of Aquarion Logos.

characters.name: Nesta
characters.description: A mysterious angel-like figure who looks just like Maia and seems to be behind Sougon's plans. Broken Bird:Losing her lover and being lead to believe he died hating and resenting her broke Nesta very badly. Died Happily Ever After:She reunites with her lover and she finally gets to know he never stopped loving her and never blamed her for his death. Evil Laugh: Seems to be very fond of these. Excessive Evil Eyeshadow

characters.name: Sakko Ootori
characters.description: A second year who is a notorious troublemaker who skips class to do parkour around town instead. Crazy Jealous Guy: He immediately hates Sun and tells he's a bad influence on Momohime despite having no evidence for it. ConsideringSakko is following Nanook'sReincarnation Romanceand Sun intends to merge with Momohime, he has more reasons for it than he realizes. Then he develops feelings for Sun himselfdue to Sun and Momohime being aDivided Deity. Dirty Coward:In the Mythic Space his missing emotion get amplified, causing him to neglect Momohime and worry about his own safety. He grows out of it while around her. Establishing Character Moment: He shows up at Sayo's funeral late, dressed casually and after hopping over a fence, with a wrong-colored carnation (pink instead of white since it's Sayo'sTragic Keepsake). He cares about Sayo, but does not care about what others think of him. Fearless Fool: The issue with Sakko's heart is that he doesn't feel fear. This is portrayed as an issue as it leads to him being reckless since he was a kid, and not bothering defending himself against attackswhile he charges ahead. Thankfully, Aquarion is piloted by three people, and the other two can address this by telling him to focus.

characters.name: Rimiya Tsukishiro
characters.description: A second year like Sakko from a different class. Rimiya has a friendly disposition which earned him a lot of friends, but he always seems a bit distant and cold. Blue Means Smart One: Has a dark blue color theme and is the logical one in the group. Brutal Honesty: Has a tendency to say things as they are, even when it's a sensitive topic. Everyone calls him out. Defrosting Ice Queen: He acts asThe Stoica lot less oncehe and Momohime regain theirPast-Life Memories. Innocently Insensitive: Rimiya is noted to have some kind of problem with the heart even more than others. While he can be emotional, he misses cues when he's supposed to relate to others.

characters.name: Toshi Hatano
characters.description: A second year in Rimiya's and Sayo's class. Shy and awkward, Toshi has a lot of problem fitting into his class along with keeping up with the school, which makes him a bit of an outcast. Ambiguously Evil:Becomes the vice-president of Sun's Council after being exposed to hisMind Rape, agreeing that the Mythic Space can be destroyed by uniting humans as one, and gains the power to awaken people himself. Toshi is willing to throw other pilots under the bus and then help them, whichever makes more sense to him at a time. Extreme Doormat: Toshi's stated issue is the lack of curiosity, resulting him to act passively and rarely speaking up, so he usually just goes with the flow. He only agreed to be a pilot because others did. Grew a Spine: After he partially awakens to Sukuna'sPast-Life Memories, he becomes more assertive.Becomes rather unhinged after other Elements gone missing in Mythic Space for months, causing him to develop a messiah complex after tapping into more of Sukuna's memories, though he stays heroic in the end. In the Hood:After he joins Sun's cult and get own Aquarion Naushizu, he starts wearing a black hood, casting a shadow over his face and making him look more sinister.

characters.name: Sayo Ichiki
characters.description: A second year in Rimiya's and Toshi's class and childhood friend of Sakko and Momohime. Quiet and reserved, Sayo is more of a wallflower and didn't have a lot of friends. Her death-alive status causes a lot of confusion to others. Back from the Dead:The first time, some kind of world distortion cases her funeral to be partially undone, but on occasion everyone remembers things as they were.Subverted whenit appears as if she back again, but it turns out it was her identical sister Hana.Thenshe appears in Mythic Space as a silent guide. The first time, some kind of world distortion cases her funeral to be partially undone, but on occasion everyone remembers things as they were. Subverted whenit appears as if she back again, but it turns out it was her identical sister Hana. Thenshe appears in Mythic Space as a silent guide.

characters.name: Momohime Amaha
characters.description: A third year and the most popular girl in school. Cheerful, friendly and determined, Momohime seems like a girl who has it all and didn't initially make it into the Elements class due to seemingly not lacking any emotions. She was in a special class alongside Sakko and Sayo in elementary school where they became close friends. Abusive Parents: Mentions that her father and her stepmother always treated her like a failure.It's implied she's another of World Awakening Council'sArtificial Humans, thus why she's not their real daughter. Back from the Dead:Hana ends upstabbing her with a paper knife despite the precautions, but because of Sun restoring DEAVA's self-correction procedure, a quantum dispositioned version of Momohime still appears in Element class like Sayo did. Toshi tells that DEAVA will arrange Momohime to die in combat just like it did for Sayo to resolve the error. Class Princess: Likeher name suggests, she is the school idol and is admired by boys and girls alike. Cool Big Sis: Was a sister figure to Sakko and Sayo growing up since both of them lack self-preservation instincts, and she tries to be this to the other pilots as well once she joins them.She ends up being Rimiya's actual older sister byReincarnation.

characters.name: Hana Ichiki
characters.description: A first year and younger sister of Sayo. Cheerful and ditzy, she seems to be the complete opposite of her sister in every way. Ax-Crazy: Compared to other pilots whose heart issues make them haveNo Social Skills, Hana genially can't distinguish why stabbing someone isn't the same as hugging them. Despite this, everyone understands that and accepts her, and she herself tries to avoid hurting others. Bust-Contrast Duo: Compared to other female students who are drawn nearly flat in the anime's artstyle, even her sister, Hana's chest is so large she keeps her shirt partially open. Chronic Pet Killer: Hana's parents forbid her owning animals, not because she's malicious towards them, but because she'd kill them as anexpression of love. Fashionable Asymmetry: She wears a legging on one left and a sock on the other.

characters.name: Kyouko Munakata
characters.description: A teacher at Enoshima Academy. Lack of Empathy: She only cares so pilots do their job and are trained accordingly. When Toshi complained to Hana being treated as Sayo's replacement, she tells him to be quiet and let Hana to comment on it herself.When Hana decides to quit, Munakata simply tells her to get out. Mission Control: Is in charge of the pilots training and gives them instructions during combat. The Mole:At some point she switched to Space Egg Society and goes against both Toshi and the World Awakening Council, assisting the pilots in the final battle.

characters.name: Kazuhiko Saruta
characters.description: A teacher at Enoshima Academy. Ambiguously Human: Kazuhiko is aShark-Toothed Humanoid, has yellow eyes andPointy Ears, but he's not treated any differently from others. Immortality Seeker:Reveals that he knew the full extent of World Awakening Council's conspiracy to preserve social elites inside a supercomputer, and is excited to be part of them since flesh is mortal. Insufferable Genius: He does maintenance for the Vectors anddumps expositionabout quantum mechanics, but when he's involved in a conversation there's no shutting him up.

characters.name: In general
characters.description: Alien Blood: Their blood appears blue. Ambiguously Brown: They all have dark skin and are implied to have lived in the area of modern Pacific Ocean, or at least stationed their base nearby and have contacted locals. And Man Grew Proud: They have collapsed 12000 years ago for unknown reason, leaving only a Mythic Beast and Aquarion behind. Eventually, it's shown thatSukuna tried to sabotage Sedona beingAscend to a Higher Plane of Existence, but the goddess Mulua Satene didn't take not reuniting with what's hers well and unleashed aHate Plague, causing the Naacal to attack each other and curse having emotions. Clip Its Wings: Getting your wings torn off and being exiled is considered the ultimate form of punishment, which results in the loss of your emotions and your mana returning to the goddess. A House Divided:They eventually split off between the house of light who still worship the goddess, and Maluku's and Sukuna's factions who believe they should find another deity to address the mana depletion.

characters.name: Sedona
characters.description: The daughter of theHigh Priestof Moon Atea, who was picked to merge with the goddess, but her romance with Nanook became an issue. Ascend to a Higher Plane of Existence: Was chosen by the Soma pillar to become one with the goddess, asan alternativeto keeping things as-is and Sukuna trying to address the mana problem by himself.Despite Sukuna trying to get Sedona executed, Mulua Satene appears herself to take what's hers, and Sedona at present time got split between Momohime and Sun. The Chosen One: She was picked to be the next goddess, but fell in love with Nanookand got nearly punished for it due to Sukuna's manipulation. Divine Parentage:Sedona is not Atea's actual daughter, he picked her up from an egg cradle left by Mulua Satene at the Soma cave twenty years after she made him be "intimate" with her. The Dutiful Son: Follows what her father says with no objections and believes getting fused with the goddess is fine since she'll continue watching over everyone. Even when others point out that this theDeath of Personality, she gets offended they doubt the system.

characters.name: Nanook
characters.description: The son of the priest of Sun and is known as Nanook the Coward. Actual Pacifist: Is known for avoiding any kind of conflict instead of taking what he wants. That turns out to be what Sedona likes in him. Sakko actuallydislikes himsince she let Sedona be trialed without speaking up. Embarrassing Nickname: Is commonly know as "the Coward" for never showing an initiative. Foil: Sakko lacks fear and is noted to be reckless to own detriment, but takes actions when hesitation is now allowed. Nanook was cowardly and passive to the point where he earned a corresponding nickname. Nay-Theist: While all Naacal worship the goddess, Nanook is skeptical that she and Soma are one in the same.

characters.name: Haida
characters.description: Sedona's younger sister who is known for being kindhearted. Be Careful What You Wish For:She tells Sukuna that it's pitiful that Futago are wingless. Since he loves to experiment and the usual punishment for Naacal is having their wings ripped off,he has plenty of material to play with that idea. While it was of great help for Futago, the method wasn't even remotely ethical.She objected to Sedona becoming the goddess sinceshe'll be separated from Nanook, andasked Sukuna to help with that. He asks to poison Sedona so her wings would become defiled and he can veto her ascension on those grounds. He tells the effect is only temporary, but as was shown in another flashback, it'sBlatant Lies, and Haida gets roped in when Sukuna arrests Atea's entire family. He asks to poison Sedona so her wings would become defiled and he can veto her ascension on those grounds. He tells the effect is only temporary, but as was shown in another flashback, it'sBlatant Lies, and Haida gets roped in when Sukuna arrests Atea's entire family. Foil: Toshi doesn't understand how others feel, in contrast Haida relates to Sedona too much and makes some bad decisions thinking she knows what's best.

characters.name: Sukuna
characters.description: All There in the Manual: Him being the creator of Aquarion is only mentioned at his profile on promotional website. Foil: Toshi lacks curiosity and assertiveness. Sukuna's pursuitsFor Science!spelled the end of Naacal civilization. Hanging Judge: He's the priest of the star of judgment, meaning he's in charge of delivering punishments and is biased for his own agenda. Mad Scientist:Got some prehistoric humans enslaved to force them to sing and test if they can be used as a mana source, and tries to implant wings to them artificially.He decides that since Mulua Satene is neglectful, they should create a newDeity of Mortal Creation. Haida says that she'll have to pray for his curiosity to not get better of him.This ended with the creation of the Mythic Beast, which started attack citizens indiscriminately for their mana, then Mulua Satene herself got enraged by the further mana deficiency this caused.He has a shelf of potions to make Naacal wings tainted, and one has to wonder how did he make those. Got some prehistoric humans enslaved to force them to sing and test if they can be used as a mana source, and tries to implant wings to them artificially.

characters.name: Futago twins
characters.description: A pair of human children who were taken in by Sukuna. The Dividual: Since they lack a personality, they don't even get individual names. Empty Shell: Since they have no wings, they also have no emotions and act completely passively. They only learn to talk after Sukuna has experimented on them. Identical Twin ID Tag: They are completely identical, but one can tell the blue one became Sayo and the pink one became Hana.

characters.name: Mulua Satene
characters.description: The goddess worshiped by the Naacal. A Form You Are Comfortable With: Sun's myth tells that Naacal were once terrorized by a giantmonstrous snake, but when the priest Atea opposed her, she took the form of his tribe out of respect and remained as their goddess. Ambiguously Evil:The ending theme shows her grabbing Sedona from behind, but her morality for taking her remains unclear even at the end.Naacal ghosts in present time mention that they act by the will of the goddess, but considering she was barely intelligent 12 millennia ago and is hardly even alive currently, this may be in a religious sense. characters.name: "Kamisama"
characters.description: A homeless man preaching about the end of the world, nicknamed "God" by passerby. Cassandra Truth: Despite coming across as aConspiracy Theorist, everything he preaches turns out to be true, including the shadow government and alien invaders.The world's self-correction usually lets everyone forget about any events proving him right, though he also runs away when adults show interest, so no one ever believes him except for Hana. Connected All Along:He was one of the World Awakening Council's scientists involved with Sun's birth, which is why he knows how they operate.He turns out to be areincarnationof Atea, Rimiya/Haida's father. characters.name: Sun
characters.description: ANew Transfer Studentat Enoshima Academy who appears to have some psychic abilities and forms the Space Egg Society. Ambiguously Evil:When he's introduced, he immediately tells that there's aDivided Deityand he is meant to "reunite" with Momohime, but she doesn't piece the two together and he isn't very insistent.When he leads a pack of zombified students, it takes a while for Sakko to realize this isn't normal, but even still he isn't sure if that's bad because he has no idea what Sun is even trying to do and the population turned happier later.World Awakening Council tells that Space Egg Society is actually opposing them, but at the moment their goals happened to be aligned, making Sun's motives even more questionable.
